title: EIA data for balancing authority AZPS
summary: Hourly demand, net generation and interchange 2015-2026, generation by fuel, and the generator inventory for AZPS, downloaded from the EIA API and summarised on this machine.

findings.statement: 2015 (partial year, 7 hours): demand 24 GWh, peak 3,642 MW at 2015-12-31 19:00 local, load factor 94%, net interchange +19 GWh (positive = net export).
2016: demand 31,353 GWh, peak 7,418 MW at 2016-06-19 19:00 local, load factor 48%, net interchange +19,657 GWh (positive = net export).
2017: demand 30,905 GWh, peak 7,558 MW at 2017-06-20 18:00 local, load factor 47%, net interchange +20,551 GWh (positive = net export); peak +1.9% and energy -1.4% on the year before.
2018: demand 30,286 GWh, peak 7,272 MW at 2018-07-24 18:00 local, load factor 48%, net interchange +20,460 GWh (positive = net export); peak -3.8% and energy -2.0% on the year before.
2019: demand 29,624 GWh, peak 7,026 MW at 2019-08-05 17:00 local, load factor 48%, net interchange +23,548 GWh (positive = net export); peak -3.4% and energy -2.2% on the year before.
2020: demand 30,839 GWh, peak 7,595 MW at 2020-07-30 18:00 local, load factor 46%, net interchange +2,567 GWh (positive = net export); peak +8.1% and energy +4.1% on the year before.
2021: demand 30,820 GWh, peak 7,586 MW at 2021-06-18 18:00 local, load factor 46%, net interchange -11,428 GWh (positive = net export); peak -0.1% and energy -0.1% on the year before.
2022: demand 31,992 GWh, peak 7,551 MW at 2022-07-11 18:00 local, load factor 48%, net interchange -10,709 GWh (positive = net export); peak -0.5% and energy +3.8% on the year before.
2023: demand 33,541 GWh, peak 8,334 MW at 2023-07-15 18:00 local, load factor 46%, net interchange -13,518 GWh (positive = net export); peak +10.4% and energy +4.8% on the year before.
2024: demand 35,913 GWh, peak 8,207 MW at 2024-08-04 18:00 local, load factor 50%, net interchange -13,650 GWh (positive = net export); peak -1.5% and energy +7.1% on the year before.
2025: demand 38,815 GWh, peak 8,499 MW at 2025-08-07 18:00 local, load factor 52%, net interchange -14,833 GWh (positive = net export); peak +3.6% and energy +8.1% on the year before.
2026 (partial year, 7,027 hours): demand 34,663 GWh, peak 8,982 MW at 2026-08-02 19:00 local, load factor 55%, net interchange -12,961 GWh (positive = net export).
2025 net generation 26,320 GWh by fuel: Natural gas 39%, Coal 25%, Solar 20%, Battery storage 8%, Wind 7%, Other 2%.

findings.location: EIA-930 hourly by fuel, last 12 months
findings.statement: On the 10 highest-demand days of the last 12 months (average peak 8,755 MW, 2026-08-02 highest), generation at the peak hour averaged: Natural gas 2,041 MW, Solar 1,469 MW, Battery storage 1,243 MW, Coal 859 MW, Wind 405 MW, Other 30 MW, Unknown storage -59 MW.
2025 net interchange with neighbouring balancing authorities (+ = export from AZPS): SRP -30,061 GWh, WALC +6,472 GWh, CISO +6,372 GWh, LDWP +2,814 GWh, PNM -275 GWh, TEPC +239 GWh.
47 hours of EIA-930 demand were dropped as bad data (zero, or a spike against the hours around it).
